5817:         (false, false, true) => "(?s)", // allow . to match \n
5818:         (true, true, false) => "(?im)", // case insensitive and multi-line mode
5819:         (true, false, true) => "(?is)", // case insensitive and allow . to match \n
5820:         (false, true, true) => "(?ms)", // multi-line mode and allow . to match \n
